description: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean outline, detailed shading. One item only, it fills most of the square, transparent background. Each item stays fully inside its own square and does not touch the edges. No pedestal, no stand, no display base, no plate, no text, no letters, no numbers, no extra objects.

items.en: pixel art item icon, dark modern Korean urban horror setting, clean dark outline around the whole object, detailed shading. an eye-only half mask, front view, wide and flat, two narrow almond-shaped eye holes slanting slightly upward, smooth hard glossy deep navy-black lacquered shell, the whole edge of the mask is finished with a raised polished gold trim band 2 to 3 pixels wide, the gold band is part of the mask, the body inside the trim stays navy-black, not a gold mask. Sleek and elegant, the animal is stylized into the mask's own shape, not a literal animal head, no ears. Mallard duck stylized: the outer tips point outward, the center over the nose extends down into a short, flat, rounded duck-bill shaped tab, the brow area has a deep iridescent dark green sheen like a mallard's head, fine feather lines engraved in gold. Only this item, nothing else beside it, no text, no halo or glow outside the object's outline, fully inside its square.
